get.summary: Get a user's permanent personal sign-in/out QR code and unique ID

post.description: Sends SMS + email + push to each emergency contact (per their notifyVia preference, or email-only if emailOnly is true). location may be either a nested object or a JSON-stringified string, both containing a coords: { latitude, longitude } shape.

location.description: Current location — object or JSON-stringified string containing coords: { latitude, longitude }

emailOnly.description: If true, only email alerts are sent (SMS and push are skipped)

201.description: Alert sent; returns the Emergency record

post.summary: Trigger a user's emergency alert to their emergency contacts
Bulk-invite organization users from a CSV file
Upload a single file to S3
Upload an emergency voice note for a user
Invite a guest visitor (generates a one-time entry QR/code)

post.description: Looks up the code as a guest invite entryCode first; if not found, falls back to a registered user's permanent personalQrCode (tenantId required in that case, since a personal QR is not bound to one fixed host the way a guest invite is).

tenantId.description: Required only when the code is a personal QR code, not a guest invite code

post.summary: Scan any code to check in / check out — guest invite code or a user's personal QR

post.description: Toggles check-in/check-out for the (user, tenant) pair, reusing (or lazily creating) a persistent Visitor record and appending a timestamped entry to its history. Equivalent to POST /visitors/verify/:code with the personal QR code as :code and tenantId in the body — kept for callers that prefer an explicit dedicated route.

tenantId.description: ID of the organization/user being signed in at

post.summary: Scan a verified user's permanent personal QR to sign in / sign out at a tenant

get.summary: List all visitor records, optionally filtered by status
Get all visitors + stats across an organization, paginated
Get all visitors + stats for a single tenant, paginated
Get visit frequency/duration stats for a visitor record
Get attendance history for a phone number across all visits

Get community group info (members, admins, metadata)

Create a detailed report (category, description, chosen recipients)

Admin: mark a report as resolved
